cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: The Handoff Already Happened
cards.instruction: Get them to accept responsibility by returning to earlier offers until the task seems to have been assigned all along.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You offered to finish the fete banner. Before signing it off, check that the raffle it advertises can actually happen.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I offered to paint the words, not organize a raffle.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then the words aren't finished yet. A complete banner needs a draw time and a prize; please fill those blanks.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll paint over 'raffle'. That finishes my job.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Only after you notify the people who bought tickets. Your offer was to finish it, not leave an incorrect announcement; start with the cancellation notice if that's your chosen finish.
